answer: Trust propagates through an attestation graph by bounded random walks, so voting weight reflects reachable, independently anchored trust rather than identities alone. A Sybil cluster S with few external attestations has low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,¬S)/vol(S); limited boundary flow and capped per-attestation weight bound its aggregate influence. A prism of fabricated identities cannot amplify trust beyond the delta allowed by genuine crossings, however long the voyage of endorsements.
